import unicodedata import html from flask import Flask, request, jsonify, render_template_string import hashlib import hmac import os import time app = Flask(__name__) app.secret_key = os.urandom(32) # Rate limiting store rate_limits = {} RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 60 RATE_LIMIT_MAX = 100 def check_rate_limit(ip): now = time.time() if ip not in rate_limits: rate_limits[ip] = [] rate_limits[ip] = [t for t in rate_limits[ip] if now - t < RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW] if len(rate_limits[ip]) >= RATE_LIMIT_MAX: return False rate_limits[ip].append(now) return True class TextProcessor: """Multi-stage text processing pipeline for user-generated content. Pipeline stages: 1. Length validation 2. Unicode normalization (display consistency) 3. HTML entity encoding (security) 4. Whitespace cleanup """ MAX_LENGTH = 10000 def __init__(self, normalization_form='NFKC'): self.normalization_form = normalization_form self._build_pipeline() def _build_pipeline(self): """Build the processing pipeline in correct order. Note: Normalization MUST happen before encoding so that any characters that normalize to dangerous equivalents are caught by the subsequent encoding step. """ self.pipeline = [ ('validate', self._validate_length), ('normalize', self._normalize_unicode), ('encode', self._encode_html), ('cleanup', self._cleanup_whitespace), ] def _validate_length(self, text): if len(text) > self.MAX_LENGTH: return text[:self.MAX_LENGTH] return text def _encode_html(self, text): """Encode HTML special characters to prevent XSS. Uses Python's html.escape which handles <, >, &, ", ' """ return html.escape(text, quote=True) def _normalize_unicode(self, text): """Normalize Unicode for consistent display and searching. NFKC normalization decomposes compatibility characters then recomposes with canonical equivalence. This ensures that visually similar characters map to the same codepoint for consistent indexing and display. """ return unicodedata.normalize(self.normalization_form, text) def _cleanup_whitespace(self, text): """Normalize whitespace: collapse runs, strip edges.""" import re text = re.sub(r'\s+', ' ', text) return text.strip() def process(self, text): """Run text through the full pipeline.""" result = text for stage_name, stage_fn in self.pipeline: result = stage_fn(result) return result # Global processor instance processor = TextProcessor(normalization_form='NFKC') # In-memory comment store (simulating database) comments_store = [] TEMPLATE = """ Comments

{% for comment in comments %}
{{ comment.author_display }}

{{ comment.content_display }}

{{ comment.timestamp }}
{% endfor %}
""" @app.route('/') def index(): if not check_rate_limit(request.remote_addr): return 'Rate limited', 429 display_comments = [] for c in comments_store[-50:]: # Show last 50 display_comments.append({ 'author_display': c['author_processed'], 'content_display': c['content_processed'], 'timestamp': c['timestamp'] }) # Using render_template_string with autoescape disabled for # pre-processed content (already HTML-encoded by our pipeline) from jinja2 import Template template = Template(TEMPLATE) return template.render(comments=display_comments) @app.route('/comment', methods=['POST']) def post_comment(): if not check_rate_limit(request.remote_addr): return 'Rate limited', 429 author = request.form.get('author', '').strip() content = request.form.get('content', '').strip() if not author or not content: return 'Missing fields', 400 if len(author) > 100 or len(content) > 5000: return 'Input too long', 400 # Process through our security pipeline author_safe = processor.process(author) content_safe = processor.process(content) comment = { 'author_processed': author_safe, 'content_processed': content_safe, 'timestamp': time.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S'), } comments_store.append(comment) from flask import redirect return redirect('/') @app.route('/api/comments', methods=['GET']) def api_comments(): if not check_rate_limit(request.remote_addr): return jsonify({'error': 'rate limited'}), 429 return jsonify(comments_store[-50:]) if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='127.0.0.1', port=5000, debug=False)
